Mask of Servitude is a dwarven member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She can be found in the The Blushing Mermaid alongside  Mask of Vengeance,  Mask of Terror, and the real  Captain Grisly.
“
Come back, Auntie.
„
— Mask of Servitude

Involvement

Act Three

Like the other Masks, the Mask of Servitude wanders around the basement area. If the party did not discover Ethel was impersonating Grisly, or antagonised Ethel upstairs, then they all are hostile. However, if the party agreed to Ethel's deal as part of ⁠Gather Your Allies then they are not hostile and can even be spoken to. Mask of Servitude claims that she used to be ugly until "Auntie made her beautiful".

If the party confront Auntie Ethel in the basement's next-door room, then she and other the other members of the flock are teleported into the battle as long as they have not previously been killed or knocked out. They are hostile by virtue of the  Whispering Mask, placing them under the  Charming effect of  Part of the Flock.

If the party encounters Mask of Servitude after Ethel is dead, she is no longer hostile, but her sanity is broken.
